title: Static Goodbye
style: lofi hip hop, mellow boom bap, dusty samples, vinyl crackle, jazzy rhodes, rainy mood, soft male vocal, low tempo 80 bpm, melancholic, late night study
lyrics:
[Intro]
(vinyl crackle, distant rain)
Mmm, yeah

[Verse 1]
Last voicemail you left is a quiet ghost
Playing on a loop with the lights turned low
The city's wearing fog like a faded coat
And I'm walking nowhere I'm afraid to go

[Verse 2]
I saved every text but I never reply
Blue light bleeding into a tired sky
Used to mean forever, now we mean goodbye
Funny how the silence learns to amplify

[Hook]
Static goodbye, static goodbye
You're a soft transmission fading from my mind
Static goodbye, static goodbye
Love on the wrong frequency, out of time

[Verse 3]
Rain on the window writing all the things
That I never said, that I never bring
Up in conversation when the phone rings
And it isn't you, it's just a memory

[Hook]
Static goodbye, static goodbye
You're a soft transmission fading from my mind
Static goodbye, static goodbye
Love on the wrong frequency, out of time

[Bridge]
(rhodes solo, soft brushes)
Maybe somewhere in the noise we're still alive
A channel only we could ever find

[Outro]
Static goodbye
(fade with rain)
